title: Planning a MAIC in information rather than in n
question: Before any data exist, which planning quantity predicts the precision a MAIC will achieve: nominal sample size, Kish effective sample size, or the estimator's influence-function variance evaluated at posited source and target laws?
design: Binary-outcome MAIC, 72 cells crossing total size, overlap, covariate dimension, allocation ratio and prevalence; each plan compared with the SD achieved over 1000 replicates.
